name: io.github.depper-IA/kommo-kiro-power
title: Kommo CRM
description: Manage Kommo CRM leads, contacts, pipelines, tasks, notes, tags and companies.

environmentVariables.name: KOMMO_SUBDOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Your Kommo account subdomain (the part before .kommo.com)

environmentVariables.name: KOMMO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Kommo OAuth access token or long-lived token

environmentVariables.name: KOMMO_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Kommo OAuth refresh token, used to renew the access token

environmentVariables.name: KOMMO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Kommo integration client ID, used to refresh tokens

environmentVariables.name: KOMMO_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Kommo integration client secret, used to refresh tokens

environmentVariables.name: KOMMO_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: OAuth redirect URI registered in the Kommo integration
